# RecDiffy.NET: FIX messages

> RecDiffy.Fix reads FIX tag=value messages strictly with FixReader, rejecting any frame that fails a check with its reason, and FixFlattener turns accepted messages into rows whose columns are tag numbers. Nothing is interpreted: the profile decides what each value means. Up: https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/llms.txt

## Pages

- [FixReader and FixFlattener](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/fix/flattener.md): reading, every check, the grain, filter, keys and reference options, the derived Counterparty, RootClOrdID, PrevExecID and {tag}:ns columns, and the options each sample profile needs

## Recipe

The rules a FIX reconciliation depends on. The column tables describe the named CSV fixtures; with FixFlattener, a profile reads tag numbers instead.

- [Who validates the wire](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/fix-recipe/who-validates-the-wire.md): framing, BodyLength, CheckSum, groups and sequence numbers
- [The rules](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/fix-recipe/the-rules.md): which messages become rows, keys and targets, the lifecycle scope, timestamps
- [FIX versions](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/fix-recipe/fix-versions.md): fills, corrections, busts and status replies in 4.2 and in 4.3 and later
- [What the fixtures show](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/fix-recipe/what-the-fixtures-show.md): every scenario and its result
- [Every section of FIX-RECIPE.md](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/fix-recipe/llms.txt)

## Sample profiles

- [generic-orders.profile.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/test-data/fix-reconciliation/generic-orders.profile.json): order states, with replaces and cancels collapsed
- [generic-fills.profile.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/test-data/fix-reconciliation/generic-fills.profile.json): fills, with corrections and busts
- [generic-equity-allocations.profile.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/test-data/fix-reconciliation/generic-equity-allocations.profile.json): our allocation instructions against the broker's confirmations
- [generic-futures-allocations.profile.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/test-data/fix-reconciliation/generic-futures-allocations.profile.json): one account against the broker's reshaped rows
- [generic-bond-allocations.profile.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/test-data/fix-reconciliation/generic-bond-allocations.profile.json): the dealer's net money and accrued

## Source and tests

- [FixReader.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix/FixReader.cs): the strict reader, and the repeating groups it knows
- [FixFlattener.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix/FixFlattener.cs): FixFlattenOptions, FixFilter, FixFlat, and the flattening
- [FixMessage.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix/FixMessage.cs): FixOptions, FixMessage, FixAccepted, FixRejected, FixSkipped and FixRejectedException
- [FixScenarioTests.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix.Tests/FixScenarioTests.cs): every sample profile run against FIX messages
- [FixFlattenerTests.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix.Tests/FixFlattenerTests.cs): grains, filters, keys, references and derived columns
